spec2def(msimtf.dll msimtf.spec)

add_idl_reg_objects(msimtf registry msimtf.idl)

# msimtf.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/msimtf-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(msimtf_shims OBJECT activeimmapp.c main.c)
target_link_libraries(msimtf_shims PRIVATE uuid wine wine_dll_register wine_dll_canunload libimm32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(msimtf_shims)
set(MSIMTF_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/dll/win32/msimtf/msimtf_r.o)
add_cargo_module(msimtf msimtf-cargo msimtf.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS msimtf_shims msimtf_r ${MSIMTF_REUSED} psdk uuid_sources)
